description: Source code for a utility that creates JCG firmware images, including headers and CRC calculations, for embedded devices.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to generate firmware images with headers and CRCs based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: mkjcgheader
methods.description: Creates and populates a JCG firmware header with CRCs and version info.

methods.name: mkuheader
methods.description: Creates and populates a modified uImage header with CRCs and image info.

methods.name: craftcrc
methods.description: Calculates and writes a patch value into a buffer to match a desired CRC.

methods.name: set_source_date_epoch
methods.description: Sets the source date epoch from environment variable for reproducible timestamps.

methods.name: opensize
methods.description: Opens a file and returns its size and file descriptor.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the utility.
